name: World Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: World Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in human resources and education, information and telecommunications, real estate, and agricultural park businesses in Japan. The company offers subcontracting, business process outsourcing, temporary staffing services, research and development, manufacturing, electromechanical design development, information technology system design development, and medical and biotechnology research and development services.
